dz: 阿拉曼斯战役(英语:Battle of Alamance)是美国革命战争前由当地民兵和一群名为"监管者"(The Regulators)的反叛者组成的战斗,发生在今北卡罗莱纳州阿拉曼斯县.
de: The Battle of Alamance, a pre-American Revolutionary War battle between local militia and a group of rebels called The "Regulators", occurs in present-day Alamance County, North Carolina.
